name: Devin Review (code review platform)
description: Full-service code review surface inside the Devin webapp. Smart diff organization, copy/move detection, bug catcher (with confidence levels), GitHub-compatible comment/approve/request-changes, codebase-aware chat, PR workflow actions (merge/close/draft/auto-merge), code-changes-from-chat. Supports GitHub Cloud + GitHub Enterprise Server. Surface URL: app.devin.ai/review.

name: SWE-Check (10x faster bug detection)
description: Cognition-built specialized model for fast bug detection in PRs. 10x faster than the prior approach. Powers the Devin Review bug-catcher with confidence-level labeling. Latency-optimized vs full agent runs.

name: SWE-1.6 (Cognition's coding model)
description: Cognition's specialized coding model. Improvements over predecessors: parallel tool calls, better UX, RL-scaled training. Available in Devin for Terminal alongside Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5.

name: Single-threaded write
description: Coordination pattern where multiple agents may read/explore in parallel but only one agent writes at a time. Cognition's documented multi-agent learning: parallel writes don't work; serial writes with parallel review do.

name: Multi-agent fleet (managed Devins)
description: Pattern of running multiple coordinated Devin sessions. Devin can now Manage Devins — coordinator-style spawning of subordinate agents. Includes scheduling Devins via cron (`Devin can now Schedule Devins`).

name: Computer Use
description: Screen + keyboard/mouse automation surface for Devin. Lets the agent interact with arbitrary GUI applications inside DevBox. Recent surface — failure modes still being characterized.

name: Skills (product feature)
description: Reusable agent capabilities surfaced through the Skills product guide. Used to encapsulate complex multi-step procedures as named, reusable units.

name: Session Insights
description: Per-session analysis surface. Shows ACU usage, timeline, agent decisions. Generated on-demand via API; surfaced in the Devin webapp post-session.

name: Scheduled Sessions
description: Cron-driven recurring or one-time agent sessions. Configured per org via the Schedules API (or UI). Triggered by cron expression + timezone.

name: Devin Session Tools
description: Debugging primitives + command palette available within an active session. Used for low-level inspection of session state.

name: Slash commands (in session)
description: Primary user lever inside a session. Slash-prefixed commands invoke specific behaviors / modes. Documented at /work-with-devin/slash-commands.

name: Ask Devin
description: Quick-question codebase Q&A surface. Answers via indexed-repo context. Org-level permission `Use Ask Devin`. Lower-cost alternative to a full session.

name: Knowledge (product feature, distinct from blueprint knowledge)
description: Persistent context Devin uses across sessions — architecture docs, conventions, team workflows. Distinct from blueprint `knowledge` section (short command refs). Per-repo: Devin only sees knowledge for the repo it's working on. Configurable in Settings > Devin's Settings > Knowledge.

name: Bot comment settings
description: Configurable PR comment rendering — controls how Devin's PR comments appear (verbosity, formatting, attribution).

name: Testing and Recordings
description: Replay/repro feature. Records session interactions for later replay or debugging.

name: SDLC integration patterns
description: Documented patterns for incorporating Devin into the SDLC: DevOps / CI loops, deployment workflows, release automation.

name: Deployment capabilities
description: Devin's capacity to drive deploy/release automation — typically through SCM integrations + CI integration.

name: Instructing Devin Effectively
description: Essential-guideline doc on prompt-engineering for Devin sessions. Companion to the good-vs-bad-instructions and when-to-use-Devin docs.

name: Good vs Bad Instructions
description: Essential-guideline doc contrasting effective vs ineffective task framing.

name: When to Use Devin
description: Essential-guideline doc on selecting tasks suited to agent execution. Covers task scoping, complexity calibration.

name: DeepWiki (Devin-generated repo docs)
description: AI-generated documentation surface for any repo. Open-source at https://github.com/CognitionAI/deepwiki. Depends on repository indexing. DeepWiki MCP server (mcp.deepwiki.com) provides public-repo programmatic access.

name: SWE-bench results / harness
description: Cognition's published benchmark results on SWE-bench. Repository at github.com/CognitionAI/devin-swebench-results includes per-eval JSON results + harness. Used as a public benchmark reference for Devin's capability progression.

name: Agent Trace (open spec)
description: Cognition-published open specification for the context graph of code that an agent traces during a session. Open vendor-neutral spec.

name: Devin 2.0 (April 2025)
description: Major Devin release (April 3, 2025). Introduced product-level upgrades documented in the Devin 2 blog post.

name: Devin 2.2 (Feb 24, 2026)
description: Latest major Devin release. Feature deltas captured in the 2026 release notes.

name: Devin Agent Preview (Sonnet 4.5)
description: September 29, 2025 release. Devin's agent preview running on Anthropic Sonnet 4.5.

name: Devin 2.1 (May 15, 2025)
description: May 15, 2025 release. Documented in the 2025 release notes.

name: Devin can now Schedule Devins (March 20, 2026)
description: March 20, 2026 release. Adds cron-driven session scheduling.

name: Devin can now Manage Devins (March 19, 2026)
description: March 19, 2026 release. Coordinator pattern: a parent Devin spawns and manages subordinate Devin sessions.

name: Devin in Windsurf (April 15, 2026)
description: April 15, 2026 release. Devin agent capabilities surfaced inside the Windsurf IDE.

name: Windsurf Codemaps (Nov 4, 2025)
description: Cognition feature surfaced via Windsurf for understanding code before edit. November 4, 2025 release.

name: AI Data Analyst (Aug 2025)
description: August 28, 2025 release. Devin used as a data-analyst — typically connected to database MCPs for ad-hoc analytics.

name: DeepWiki: AI docs for any repo (May 5, 2025)
description: May 5, 2025 release of DeepWiki — AI-generated documentation tooling.

name: DeepWiki MCP Server (May 22, 2025)
description: May 22, 2025. Launched the no-auth public-repo MCP server at mcp.deepwiki.com.

name: Audio messages in Slack (Jan 2025)
description: January 2025 product update. Devin can respond to audio messages sent via Slack — triggers session via voice clip.

name: Usage-based billing (January 9, 2025)
description: January 9, 2025. Launched pay-as-you-go billing with Additional Usage Budget cap. Bills at end of cycle OR when usage exceeds $2,000 (whichever comes first).

name: Enterprise Accounts (Jan 2025)
description: January 2025 release. Enterprise accounts enable centralized management of multiple Devin organizations — admin, billing, member access controls.

name: What We Learned Building Cloud Agents (blog)
description: Cognition blog post covering DevBox isolation, hypervisor snapshotting, async-gap survival, and the orchestration/governance/integration triad. Foundational architecture overview.

name: How Cognition Uses Devin to Build Devin (blog)
description: Cognition's own usage patterns + internal MCP integrations. Real-world fluency-building reference.

name: Itaú case study (17K engineers, 11mo)
description: Customer case study cited in the Cloud Agents blog. Itaú (largest private bank in Latin America), 11 months in with ~17,000 engineers: 5–6× faster migrations, 70% auto-remediation of static-analysis security vulnerabilities, 2× test-coverage increase.

name: Engineer fluency (operational concept)
description: Skill engineers develop by managing concurrent agent sessions over months on real projects. Distinct from writing code. Measured fluency comes from delegating + reviewing at scale.

name: Review-volume shift (org-process implication)
description: When agents do significant share of execution, code review volume increases dramatically. Review processes designed for human-authored code don't transfer cleanly. Teams must establish what rigorous review looks like at higher volume.

name: 10-ACU per-session soft cap
description: Cognition's recommended per-session ACU ceiling. Performance noticeably degrades beyond ~10 ACU. Soft (product nudges, doesn't enforce).

name: Devin Review bug-catcher confidence levels
description: Devin Review bug-catcher labels detected bugs by confidence. 'Severe' bugs require immediate attention. Lower-confidence bugs surfaced as flags.

name: Smart diff organization (Devin Review)
description: Devin Review groups changes logically (related edits together) instead of alphabetical. Makes large PRs more navigable.

name: Copy/move detection (Devin Review)
description: Devin Review detects when code has been copied or moved and displays as a copy/move instead of full delete + insert. Reduces noise in refactor PRs.

name: Codebase-aware chat (Devin Review)
description: PR-level chat that pulls in context from the rest of the codebase. Can ask Devin from any comment, bug, or flag in the diff view.

name: Code changes from chat (Devin Review)
description: Ask Devin Review's chat to make code edits; review the suggested changes; apply as a commit to the PR branch without leaving the surface.

name: PR workflow actions (Devin Review)
description: Merge / close / convert-to-draft / mark-ready-for-review / toggle-auto-merge directly from Devin Review. No need to switch to GitHub.

name: GitHub compatibility (Devin Review)
description: Devin Review's comments / approvals / change-requests sync back to GitHub bidirectionally. Supports GitHub Cloud + GitHub Enterprise Server.

name: docs.devin.ai sitemap.xml
description: Master URL inventory at https://docs.devin.ai/sitemap.xml. ~264 KB at fetch time. Used by Phase 1 ingest to enumerate Mintlify pages.

name: docs.devin.ai llms.txt
description: AI-friendly index at https://docs.devin.ai/llms.txt. ~52 KB. Lists all available pages — used by AI agents to discover the documentation structure.

name: Release notes — 2024
description: 2024 release notes covering June 2024, September 2024, December 2024 (parts 1 + 2) updates. ~24 KB.

name: Release notes — 2025
description: 2025 release notes — biggest year for new features (DeepWiki, Devin 2.0/2.1, Sonnet 4.5 preview, audio in Slack, enterprise accounts, AI Data Analyst, Codemaps, Devin Review, multi-agent updates). ~47 KB.

name: Release notes — 2026
description: 2026 release notes — Devin can Manage Devins, Devin can Schedule Devins, Devin in Windsurf, Devin 2.2, Devin for Terminal. ~40 KB.

name: CognitionAI/deepwiki repo
description: Open-source companion to DeepWiki (license unverified at fetch time; treated as private-corpus-only ingest). Supplements docs with implementation detail.

name: User best practices (limitations, hallucinations, branch protection)
description: Documented user-side guardrails. Devin may hallucinate, introduce bugs, or suggest insecure code. Recommended: code reviews, branch protections, standard org review processes.

name: Session inline-keyword cheatsheet
description: Session-control keywords usable in Slack/Teams: !ask, !deep, mute, unmute, sleep, archive, EXIT, (aside), help; plus Slack-specific !dana, !fast, ![macro_name].
